correctness.rationale: Lindenhovius' Artinian-poset theorem supplies the all-nuclei subset parametrization; for the upset algebra of the complete r-by-s height-two order, write parameters B in the lower Boolean algebra and A in the upper Boolean algebra. The direct cone evaluation yields the displayed top and bottom actions. Comparing two composite closure maps gives commutation exactly when B\D nonempty implies C subseteq A and D\B nonempty implies A subseteq C. An inclusion relation between unequal lower indices forces the same strict order on unequal upper indices: a cycle in the bipartite edge incidence graph would give two distinct order-preserving increasing perfect matchings between the same finite chains, impossible. Hence the graph is a forest with at most 2^r+2^s-1 edges; an inclusion-extremal spanning tree forces all nonextreme bottom subsets to share one extreme upper neighbour and yields the two and only two extremizers. Partitioning ordered lower-subset pairs into equality/strict comparable/incomparable cases and counting compatible upper pairs gives 2^r*4^s + 2(3^r-2^r)3^s +(4^r-2*3^r+2^r)2^s, with balanced probability asymptotic 2(9/16)^n. Independently reimplemented all-upset direct composition and the Boolean implication for (r,s)=(2,2),(2,3),(3,2), obtaining 162,542,542 commuting ordered pairs; the packages' larger finite output is corroboration not an infinite proof.
residual_risks: Assumes r,s>=2 and the complete two-level incidence order; equality classification does not automatically extend to other frames.
The complete all-size proof is the written forest and equality argument, not finite r,s enumeration.

value.rationale: The largest mutually composition-commuting class of closure modalities is a natural algebraic and logical invariant: maximal family structure can matter for simultaneous valid closure operations. The theorem proves a sharp two-parameter cap, precisely classifies its two equality families and computes the probability of commutation for arbitrary r,s, exposing a nontrivial exponentially rare regime when r=s grows. This is not a mere renaming of the known Artinian subset/nucleus bijection; the new obstruction is compatibility across two incomparable Boolean layers.
residual_risks: Value is confined to complete two-level finite Heyting frames, not a classification of every finite frame.

limitations: No classification of inclusion-maximal nonmaximum families or arbitrary height-two posets.
